title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (Worldwide)
summary: Hold: the briefing omits the licence prerequisite for viewing agent risk in the Microsoft 365 admin center and unnecessarily restricts who can configure policies. It also assigns containment to agent owners even though Microsoft documents administrator actions for stopping Foundry agents. The roadmap facts, default policy behaviour and listed commands are supported.
